task.description: Step 1: Diagnose root cause of missing secret_ref/secret_key_id in tenant_default.webhook_subscriptions despite migration 1134 being recorded as applied.
acceptance_criteria: Explain exactly why columns were not added

result.summary: Category E (Environment/Timing gap). Migration 1134 ran in public pass on 2026-08-08T02:43:38Z. All 21 SCHEMA-mode tenant schemas (including tenant_default) were provisioned AFTER this timestamp, so webhook_subscriptions did not exist in any tenant schema when migration 1134 iterated tenants. Its IF EXISTS guard correctly no-opped, but was never re-run since the public-pass ledger row prevents re-application. Fix: new migration 1138_iss0635_webhook_secret_ref_corrective.sql with scope all_schemas (runs in every tenant pass, idempotent ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS).
result.next_action: Route to BACKEND-DEV (Step 2) to implement migration 1138
